long_biography.plain_text:
Gmyra trained as a naval engineer and entered the recreational-vessel industry in 2006. He worked on construction projects in Turkey, Italy and Russia, moved into vessel sales, and completed shipyard training in Viareggio. By 2010 he was working with a team on vessel design and construction. That progression gave him experience across the commercial, engineering and client-facing parts of the sector.

Baikal Yachts Group became Gmyra's founder-led platform for developing motor vessels, catamarans, houseboats and floating-residence concepts for Russian waterways and international markets. Gmyra has also spoken publicly about constraints facing domestic builders, including limited yard capacity, financing and infrastructure. Alongside his maritime work, he holds a Russian patent for a method of developing mental abilities, reflecting an earlier interest in cognitive-training products.
